title: plan
description: What `wilanis-deploy --target plan` prints (RFC 0024): what one deployment of one tree is, as one JSON object on stdout, computed by the pure `planOf` from the tree's manifest (RFC 0026) and the profiles asked for. It never reads the environment, the clock or a secret's value: a variable is named, never valued. Every other target renders this plan and reads nothing else, so a target someone else writes needs nothing from this package but it. Every array is sorted, in code units, by its first key; every reference is canonical, as the manifest prints it. From 1.0 a field is added, never removed or retyped, and `format` is bumped for a breaking change; before 1.0 nothing is promised.

format.description: Which envelope this is. 1 until a change a reader could not ignore, which takes the next number.

name.description: The tree's name, as project.json says it and the manifest prints it.

node.description: The Node versions the tree's package.json says it runs on, its engines.node verbatim, as the manifest prints it; null where it names none. What an image's base is chosen by.

image.description: The one image every workload runs: a tree's profiles share their documents and node_modules, and only the command differs.

context.description: The directory the image is built from, relative to the tree's root.

dockerfile.description: The file that builds it, relative to the tree's root.

reference.description: The reference the image is tagged with, as the command was given it: the tree's name and its package.json version (customers:0.1.0), or latest where it gives none.

workloads.description: One process per profile asked for, by profile.

requires.description: What the environment must provide: every connection an asked profile reaches whose kind declares an endpoint, by connection. A floor, not a census: a connection of a kind that declares none is not listed.

workload.description: One profile's process: how it starts, what it listens on and holds open, the variables it needs, and how it is known to be up.

profile.description: The profile this process runs under, as project.json names it; "" for the unnamed profile of a tree that declares none.

description.description: The profile's description, as project.json writes it; null where it writes none.

command.description: The command the process starts with, run in the tree's root: wilanis start . --profile <name>, and without --profile for the unnamed profile.

items.description: One word of the command, passed as it is, with no shell between.

listens.description: Every address the profile's startup binds, by operation and then port: what a container publishes and a Service routes to.

holds.description: Every operation the profile's startup holds open, by operation, as the manifest prints them; never empty, since a profile that holds nothing is refused.

needs.description: Every variable the profile reads, by variable and then key: named, never valued.

replicas.description: How many of the process to run: 1, since until RFC 0005 a tree may keep sessions and blobs on its instance's disk and a second replica would not see them.

probe.description: How the process is known to be up: its first listened port accepting a connection, since the startup opens the port only after every step before it succeeded; null where it listens on nothing.

listen.description: One address a profile's startup binds.

operation.description: The operation that binds it, <port>#<operation>, whose port document declares listens.

host.description: The interface, as the tree writes it: a literal, or a {{secrets.*}} read kept as its text; null where nothing is written, which is every interface.

port.description: The port the tree fixes. Always a number: an address whose port a secret supplies, or nothing fixes, is refused.

variable.description: The environment variable, as project.json's secrets map the key to it.

key.description: The secret key the variable answers, as a {{secrets.<key>}} read names it.

readBy.description: Everyone who reads it, sorted: a connection's path, or @<plugin> settings.

probe.description: A readiness check on a TCP port.

tcp.description: The port a connection is attempted on: the first one the workload listens on.

requirement.description: One connection the environment must let the tree reach.

connection.description: The connection document, by path; the stand-in a profile chose where it chose one.

kind.description: The connection kind, by path, whose endpoint says which setting is the address.

endpoint.description: What that setting holds, as the connection writes it: a {{secrets.*}} read stays its text, and the value never appears.

reachedBy.description: The asked profiles that reach it, sorted.

items.description: A profile, as project.json names it.
